column2: I thank you for freeing me{0000}from this world of carnage.{0010}But a contest, whenever it may be,{0000}is always a sorrowful thing.{0010}Yet as long as someone is driving{0000}"Fukumaden" mad,{0010}we must keep on fighting.{0010}Will the fighting go on still?{0010}

Fighting breeds new enemies,{0000}and so it goes on in a chain.{0010}Fighting is such an empty thing.{0010}I will search for a world{0000}without strife. Surely, somewhere,{0010}there must be a peaceful world.{0010}

Hmm... So, want to fight like this?{0010}

Hmph.{0000}A gutless fellow, I say.{0010}You should've handed over the stone{0000}and fought fair and square.{0010}Not that you'd stand a chance.{0010}
You're strong, I say!{0010}But I wasn't fighting{0000}at full power, I say.{0010}

It's no lie, I say. In this world{0000}there's a wondrous stone called{0010}the "Rainbow Stone." With it,{0000}you'd be no match for me, I say!{0010}

It exists, I say. Why, I had it{0000}myself just a moment ago!{0010}

Without it, I can't face{0000}the Holly clan, I say.{0010}
Then I'll look for it{0000}for you, so wait here.{0010}
I'm counting on you, I say.{0010}
(He could've just asked me{0000}to look for it...){0010}
Looks like I fought{0000}an embarrassin' fight! Shoot!{0010}Well, I fought you fair and square,{0000}so I feel good even if I lost.{0010}
Ah, it's Kofuku!{0000}Long time no see!{0010}
Oh! It's Jakuya! Then is{0000}Mingobee with you too?{0010}
Right here, man! Today marks{0000}exactly 2000 days{0010}since we parted ways.{0000}A day worth celebratin'!{0010}
We gotta celebrate big!{0010}
What are you about to start? Please,{0000}could you do it later?{0010}
Yeah! Can't throw a big party{0000}here! Kofuku, hurry up{0010}and come play with us!{0010}

Shoot! Guess I'm the one who{0000}fought the embarrassin' fight!{0010}Well, I fought you fair and square,{0000}so I feel good even if I lost.{0010}By the way... Ain't ya got Jakuya{0000}and Mingobee with ya?{0010}I wanted to play with 'em again.{0010}

Yeah! It's more fun{0000}with those guys around!{0010}
That shot had my soul in it.{0000}If it didn't work,{0010}then I've lost...{0010}You hold my life in your hands.{0000}Do with it as you like.{0010}
Become my shikigami!{0010}
I've served many humans and{0000}seen many of them live and die.{0010}Making a contract with me{0000}means you and I{0010}share life and death.{0000}Do you understand that?{0010}

Before it's a fight between shikigami,{0000}never forget it's a fight between{0010}humans. In short, if your shikigami{0000}falls, you won't get off{0010}lightly either.{0010}If you understand that,{0000}I'll accept the contract.{0010}

Before it's a fight between shikigami,{0000}never forget it's a fight between{0010}humans.{0010}If I fall, you surely won't{0000}get off lightly either.{0010}If you fight without that resolve,{0000}you had better change.{0010}I seem to have talked too long.{0000}Until we meet again. Farewell!{0010}
To be taken by the evil aura not{0000}once, but twice, eh...{0010}It seems I've caused you{0000}quite a lot of trouble.{0010}
Let's make a contract!{0010}

Oho.{0010}Wanting a contract with me?{0000}You're quite an odd one, eh.{0010}A contract with the likes of me{0000}won't necessarily do you{0010}much good, you know...{0010}Taking in an old man like me...{0000}You may have a big heart after all.{0010}Being easygoing is my only strength,{0000}but I'm in your care, my boy.{0010}

Lost is lost, can't be helped.{0000}I got no complaints.{0010}So what do ya want?{0010}

No way! I lost this time, but{0000}next time won't go like this!{0010}No matter what, I wanna{0000}beat you!{0010}

Woo-hoo! I win!{0010}See, the heart of any contest{0000}is winning!{0010}Sorry for ya, but{0000}our contract's gonna{0010}have to wait! So long!{0010}

You formed a contract with Tsuiga Red.{0010}
